coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward (landscape page 792 x 612). Rule in the picture: its x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10.
how_measured: Browser print (landscape) of an HTML exhibit made of seven scanned page pictures (935 x 1210 px). Each picture is drawn twice, split over two PDF pages: page CTM .24 0 0 -.24 0 612 and picture cm 2031.25 0 0 -2628.1248 628.125 2743.7498 (first page) or ... 424.99976 (second page), clipped to y 27.75-583.75. So x = 150.75 + col * 487.5/935 and y = 27.75 + row * 630.75/1210 on the first page (top -528.75 on the second); the page break falls at picture row 1066.6. Rules found in the picture pixels (rows darker than 170, runs with gaps of 4 px or less, 30 px or longer; handwriting crossing a rule checked row by row); all seven pictures looked at at full resolution; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Executed scanned copy of a single-subscriber agreement: name, amount and dates were typed in before signing; the subscriber signed and wrote address and e-mail on the last picture, and the company signed its acceptance under it (page 20).

sure_per_page.20: sure of the five printed rules; every other entry on the page was typed before signing

1: page 1 holds only the EDGAR header line; pages 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 and 19 are blank leftovers of the split pictures
2: the double rule around the agreement title (picture 1)
the subscriber name, share count and price typed into the first paragraph: filled in, no blank
11: footnote rules on pictures 4 and 5 (pages 11 and 14)
20: the typed "Dated:" date and the typed subscriber name beside "Name:" (twice): filled in before execution, no blank printed
the typed acceptance date, officer name and title: filled in
the underlines of the labels "Name:", "By:", "Address:", "Email address:" and of "ACCEPTANCE": underlined words
the handwriting and signatures themselves (personal data; not copied)
